rootCause.summary: Checkout completed successfully: the checkout service started and recorded completion (file:EV-0015 -> file:EV-0019). The payment was received by the payment service (api:EV-0016), recorded as committed in the ledger (database:EV-0017), and the payment service reported success with HTTP 200 (api:EV-0018). All three data sources (file, api, database) contain a consistent causal chain for attempt PA1 within the investigation window, supporting that the transaction succeeded.
limitations: No external acquirer/settlement network logs available here — ledger commit (database:EV-0017) is the strongest internal evidence of settlement but does not prove final settlement at an external PSP.
Timestamps derive from service records; small clock skew between services is possible but does not conflict with the observed causal sequence.
Investigation limited to the provided time window and the recorded trace/attempt (PA1).

failureFlow.event: checkout.started — Checkout started for TX9004 (attempt PA1).
payment.received — Payment attempt received by payment service (causedByEventId EV-0015).
payment.committed — Ledger recorded decision COMMITTED (causedByEventId EV-0016).
payment.succeeded — Payment service reported success (httpStatus 200, causedByEventId EV-0017).
checkout.succeeded — Checkout completed and transaction marked SUCCEEDED (causedByEventId EV-0018).

recommendation.action: Confirm external settlement/reconciliation with payment provider (PSP) or acquirer for TX9004 if your financial process requires PSP confirmation.
recommendation.reason: Internal ledger shows COMMITTED (database:EV-0017) and payment service reported HTTP 200 (api:EV-0018), but external settlement logs are not present in the collected evidence.

recommendation.action: Record or archive the successful transaction in merchant reporting and notify downstream systems that rely on ledger commit.
recommendation.reason: Checkout and payment sequence completed and ledger commit recorded, supporting downstream fulfillment or order processing.

recommendation.action: If you require higher assurance, instrument and collect PSP/acquirer callbacks or settlement confirmations into the same trace for future end-to-end proof.
recommendation.reason: This will remove the remaining limitation about external settlement visibility noted in the root-cause limitations.
